Steve Jobs asked Linus to work at Apple in the 2000s. The catch? He had to drop Linux completely. Linus gave a flat 'NO'. Can you imagine what the tech world would look like today if he'd accepted the Apple money? Check out our debate on the pod!

🎧 Listen on Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/episode/3sQY3Ga0qVAqI4DmlFxUa2
